generalization_findings.finding: The P7 completion change fixed the B0 under-authoring failure mode on the newly frozen held-out B1 cohort.
generalization_findings.evidence: All 14 tracepixel-post-p7-v1 trials completed all six required authoring stages with mean applied_stages 6, mean skipped_stages 0, completion 1.0 and structural pass rate 1.0; owner human rejection fell from 5/14 for the B0 staged method to 0/14 in B1.

generalization_findings.finding: Held-out B1 does not support a claim that the post-P7 TracePixel method is perceptually superior to the matched raw baseline.
generalization_findings.evidence: Both methods averaged 4.0 recognizability. Raw averaged 4.0 native-1x readability and 3.9285714285714284 style coherence; TracePixel averaged 3.642857142857143 and 3.857142857142857. Raw had one human rejection while TracePixel had none, so the dimensions do not collapse to a single winner.

generalization_findings.finding: Once under-authoring is removed, the six-stage TracePixel traversal is materially more expensive than the matched raw baseline in this cohort.
generalization_findings.evidence: TracePixel/raw mean ratios were about 5.0647x input tokens, 4.6660x output tokens, 4.9412x provider calls and iterations, 5.8235x operation calls, 5.2272x changed pixels, 4.9035x pixel edits and 4.5783x wall time.

generalization_findings.finding: B1 does not validate the effectiveness of the targeted repair path even though the P7 repair architecture is present.
generalization_findings.evidence: tracepixel-post-p7-v1 averaged 0 repair cycles across all 14 trials, so no scored B1 conclusion about repair quality or repair efficiency is justified.

architecture_followups.action: Scale through an AssetSet contract that reuses the single-asset pipeline per member, isolates member failures and retains per-member evidence; keep concurrency explicit and bounded.
Make aggregate provider/token/wall-time budgets first-class before batch fan-out so the roughly 4.6-5.1x staged cost observed in B1 cannot be hidden by aggregate success rates.
Add cross-asset style/palette consistency as an explicit versioned contract without weakening the rule that deterministic QA and human perception are separate authorities.

Investigate lower-cost stage guidance or stage coalescing only behind provider-free/development-visible evidence; never restore the B0 behavior where global structural pass prematurely ended required authoring.
Exercise targeted repair deliberately in a newly preregistered future cohort before claiming repair generalization; B1's zero repair cycles are insufficient evidence.

required_guards: reuse the proven single-asset member pipeline

owner_gates_crossed.gate: G6 home Windows self-hosted preview runner
owner_gates_crossed.basis: explicit repository-owner activation recorded on issue #79 before B1-S0 execution
owner_gates_crossed.scope: owner-run B1 provider execution only; public pull-request CI remains hosted

claim_boundary: B1 is a held-out post-P7 generalization diagnostic. It supports that required staged completion and deterministic structural success generalize across this frozen small-asset cohort, but it supports no composite winner, no universal art-quality claim, no perceptual-superiority claim for TracePixel, and no repair-efficacy claim.
